author: Kevin Stratvert
description:
This QuickBooks Payroll tutorial for beginners walks you through running your first payroll with confidence.
💰 Get started with Quickbooks Payroll ➜ https://qbpayroll.kevinstratvert.com/ 

First, you’ll compare QuickBooks Payroll plans: Core, Premium, and Elite. So you can choose based on same-day direct deposit, mobile time tracking, job costing, and penalty protection. 

Next, you’ll pin the Payroll app, use the Getting Started wizard, and lock in your business address, payroll admin, and first pay date so taxes and forms calculate correctly. 

Then, you’ll import employees from a spreadsheet and send invites so your team can onboard themselves in the QuickBooks Workforce app. 

Afterward, you’ll review the key employee settings you control—pay type, default hours, account mapping, extra pay types, time-off policies, and deductions—without getting lost in the clutter. 

Next, you’ll set up Auto Tax and add payroll history so year-to-date totals are accurate.
